page: OVHcloud b2-15 is a general-purpose virtual server hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Haswell processor running at 2.0 GHz. The configuration provides 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with no hyperthreading. It includes 15.0 GB of system memory, yielding 3.75 GB per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 100 GB SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the legacy Intel Haswell architecture delivers modest compute capabilities. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance falls in the bottom 10%, while multi-core performance is in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth for small cached blocks is average at 347.69 GB/sec, but drops to a weaker 37.17 GB/sec for larger uncached blocks. Database operations and small-model LLM inference perform at average levels, whereas larger workloads like 7B LLM inference and Redis SET operations show weaker results.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and modest hardware profile, the b2-15 offers a predictable, cost-efficient resource tier for workloads that do not require high-frequency processors or modern instruction sets like AVX-512. It is best suited for general-purpose tasks, basic database operations, static web serving, and lightweight application hosting where dedicated core access is preferred over shared-core burstable instances.
